_comment: Plain-language 'What changed' entries for commits made before the Release-note: trailer existed. Keys are commit hash prefixes (7+ chars). kind: new | fix | improved | change | docs (docs are never shown). New commits carry their own note as a trailer: 'Release-note: fix: <one plain sentence>'.

3c9280d.title: A real answer about your own app's API quota is never mistaken for a provider's billing message

307d035.title: Agent sessions no longer fail silently: Google Gemini is used again after the first tool call, relay billing messages are never shown as answers, and a turn no model can serve stops and says why

c9c2fd7.title: Low-memory mode: fewer parallel workers on weak or busy machines (Auto, On or Off)

5d3aaac.title: Skills: switch each built-in skill on or off, and add your own named skills

36b95cf.title: Agents stop the servers they started on the first try in Git Bash

be0a6a3.title: A provider that refuses outside apps, or is down, is no longer reported as dead keys

559b204.title: Agents stop only the servers they started (by process ID or port), never the hub

eed9754.title: Provider cards show “No API key” and how many keys are dead; broken keys are skipped automatically

b1ecee8.title: One-click health check: tests every provider and key, then gives recommendations

dd55529.title: A server blocking the agent's shell is caught after about 60 seconds instead of 7 minutes

30262cf.title: A calm green outline around the folded top bar

6dab905.title: Click the top line to fold or unfold it

0391b82.title: Tabs and the run bar share one row, so the preview gets more height

5f818ef.title: No more empty space above the first row

c49f712.title: The folded top bar is one thin line; phones keep a large tap target

03cbdde.title: A button folds the top controls into a one-line summary

ff8a638.title: A category whose models all fail now falls back to a few healthy models outside it

b529b7d.title: A run is never lost when Windows briefly locks its file

3f48874.title: One clean answer per request: glued double answers are cut, and a model that only announced an action is retried

1197fd6.title: Agents start servers in the background and resume correctly when a server blocks

ec171a3.title: Pixel Canary now ranks above Kimi K3 and GPT-6
